notes: Supersedes Mandate's earlier 86.5% estimate (which cited NYC's Independent Budget Office secondhand). This is a Mandate-computed unweighted average across NYC's five pension systems, pulled directly from each system's own Actuarial Valuation Report (NYC Office of the Actuary), Actuarial-Value-of-Assets basis, valuation date 6/30/2022 (maps to FY2024 per each report's own Table I-1): NYCERS 82.5%, TRS 85.5%, BERS 94.3%, POLICE 85.1%, FIRE 71.6%. NYC publishes no single blended figure; a market-value-of-assets-basis alternative also exists and is more volatile (e.g. FIRE MVA 70.3% vs AVA 72.4% for a nearby year) -- this row uses the smoothed AVA basis.
